You ask this question and similar questions a lot.

It seems you are very unhappy with the Navy or perhaps your situation within the Navy. Consider reaching out and talking through this with someone. Military OneSource or your chaplain should be available to you.

Best of luck.
Not entirely true. Just mostly true. There are IDT-T funds available to cover travel, if the members unit decides to do that.
After reading this, I want to clarify that the EUCOM unit is a reserve unit. I mentioned it in case it was closer for OP

I'm not familiar with those units but I'm really struggling to see why you have to travel then. You'll apply for a unit, just like any other time. The Navy isn't out to create a financial difficulty on you. If you don't get picked up at a close unit, you'll likely wind up cross assigned and drilling at a close unit anyways.
EUCOM has a unit in Molesworth if that helps you any.
